title: Theory of Optimal and Robust Control
alt: A cart balancing a double pendulum upright
summary: A rigorous introduction to optimal and robust control. Robust control: model reduction, H<sub>2</sub> and H<sub>∞</sub> control, and feedback control of uncertain systems. Optimal control: the linear quadratic regulator, the calculus of variations, the maximum principle and the Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equation.

title: Dynamic Programming and Stochastic Control
alt: A maze solved by value iteration
summary: The theory of dynamic programming for sequential decisions under uncertainty: the DP algorithm and its optimality conditions, linear-quadratic problems, inventory control and asset selling, imperfect state information, and infinite-horizon problems with approximate DP.
